description: A module with no controls of its own, whose purpose is to put a Night-bin button on Rack's menu bar for fetching nightly builds of plugins from GitHub
notes: the panel carries nothing that can be clicked; everything the module does is on the Night-bin button it adds to Rack's own menu bar, and removing the module removes the button
a plugin can be checked only if it publishes its source on GitHub and has a release tagged Nightly holding a .vcvplugin file for your operating system and processor
a downloaded build is written into Rack's plugins folder and takes effect at the next restart of Rack
a red dot on the Night-bin button means an update was found, and the button's text reports progress while it is querying or downloading
the plugin's settings, including the access token in plain text and the list of plugins to check, are kept in questionablemodules.json in Rack's user folder
menu: Add / Remove Modules — on the Night-bin button in Rack's menu bar; lists every installed plugin, and clicking one adds it to the list that is checked or takes it off
Add All Plugins — inside Add / Remove Modules on the Night-bin button in Rack's menu bar; adds every plugin that names a GitHub source, and appears only once a token has been entered
Query for Updates — on the Night-bin button in Rack's menu bar; checks each chosen plugin's GitHub repository for a Nightly release newer than the installed build
Github Access Token — on the Night-bin button in Rack's menu bar; a text field for a GitHub personal access token, which raises the limit GitHub puts on unauthenticated requests
Clear Github Access Token — on the Night-bin button in Rack's menu bar; deletes the stored token, and replaces the text field once a token has been entered
Update All — on the Night-bin button in Rack's menu bar; downloads every update the last query found
